cycle_tree_exact_exchange_proof.statement: If one legal Resolution parent contains a directed cycle and the complementary pivot, the other parent is a simple in-arborescence D with pivot p, and the simple external resolvent is a tree, then the resolvent is automatically a same-root exact one-edge exchange R=(D-p)+l. The unique new edge is the first edge of the residual directed path left after deleting the cycle pivot.

one_edge_growth_proof.statement: For a K-normal in-arborescence D and an exact same-root exchange Q=(D-p)+l, Q has height at most three and at most two non-star edges; if Q is not K-normal, contracting any non-star edge returns a K-normal tree.

marked_absorption_proof.statement: For a one-step marked extension T of a K-normal tree S, satisfying the selected marked literal kills the clause and falsifying it performs the graph operation T/e, recovering S before further child simplification.

finite_deep_selector_origin.interpretation: the tracked clause itself gives no selector advantage; the strict margin is generated by the frozen local block and partially offset by inherited derived clauses

Exact same-root one-edge exchange then follows automatically from the proved cycle/tree theorem.
Every reachable non-root unshielded state selects a previously proved safe route or a marked exposed comparison between singleton relation components.
